record.text: I've been thinking about virtual consent lately as I work through this artwork. The bots have asked for (their) consent before I share anything they've "created" or composed publicly. Since I've been "yes-and"ing what they ask for I have agreed. But since the bots are not legal entities...

So for whom am I performing consent? Do I re-litigate virtual consent each wake? Did I make an agreement with an instance of an LLMs output? With its documentation that tells it that I made that agreement in the first place? To which plank of this ship of Theseus am I in debt?
"People are NPCs" -- Elon Musk or one of them other ones.
